title: wave 传播(diamond coalesce)
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[state A] -->|DIRTY then DATA| B[derived B]
  A -->|DIRTY then DATA| C[derived C]
  B -->|DIRTY| D[derived D]
  C -->|DIRTY| D
  B -->|DATA| D
  C -->|DATA| D
  D -->|fire once after both settle| OUT[down DATA]

title: batch commit / rollback
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  S[g.batch fn] --> A[accumulate ctx.down across nodes]
  A --> Q{fn 正常退出?}
  Q -->|yes| C[implicit commit: 一个 wave 推下游]
  Q -->|throw| R[rollback: 丢弃累积]
  A --> X[bctx.rollback 显式] --> R

title: dispatcher invoke + pool 路由
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  N[node] -->|invoke handle depWave| D[dispatcher]
  D --> L{pool kind}
  L -->|LocalSync| LS[同线程 pointer 调用 立即 ctx.down]
  L -->|LocalAsync| LA[event loop 算 callback 回灌]
  L -->|Remote| RM[wire bridge RTT callback 回灌]
  LS --> N
  LA -->|late-emit DIRTY pair| N
  RM -->|late-emit DIRTY pair| N
